name: nyerat
description: Editor Markdown ala Typora dengan GTK 3 dan GJS
author: Eka Putra <eka@ekaput.com>

scripts.test: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/run-tests.js --with-kanban-mouse
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/run-tests.js --with-kanban-mouse
scripts.bench: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js
scripts.bench:save: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js --save=bench/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).json
scripts.bench:compare: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js --compare=bench/baseline.json
scripts.docs: npm run build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$(mktemp -d) gjs -m dist/capture.js
